emily: Noticed multiple SAST runs failing overnight with 403s when fetching secrets after RBAC tidy. Example pipeline #4721.

tony: Can you paste the error snippet?

emily: ```ERROR fetcher: access denied (403)
caused by: kms:Decrypt PermissionDenied
path: scanner/fetch.go:88```

yara: Likely the keystore role for scanner SA got narrowed. Check IAM audit diff around 2024-06-20T02:00Z.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2024-2001 created: "sast artifact decrypt failures". Paging @yara @emily.

tony: Mitigation: create a conditional, time-limited decrypt binding for scanner SA for 30m to unblock CI. Log grant id and export audit logs.

emily: Applied temp binding, pipeline #4721 now passes. Exported artifacts to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-2001/.

yara: Follow-ups: (1) design a scoped role allowing decrypt only for artifact key with resource-name condition (2) add infra pre-merge IAM simulation test to catch removals (3) add alert rule for repeated `kms:Decrypt` or `403` in SAST/DAST jobs.

emily: Filing GH issues: #2010 (iam-smoke), #2011 (scanner-key-role), #2012 (pipeline-auth-alert). Postmortem scheduled. Closing thread.
